newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Norway to help Guatemalan guerrillas disarm.
newsitem.headline: Norway to help Guatemalan guerrillas disarm.

text.p: Norway on Friday promised $3.6 million to aid the disarmament and return to civilian life of Guatemalan guerrillas following a historic peace agreemnent signed on Sunday, officials said.

The peace agreement between the Guatemalan government and rebels of the Guatemalan National Revolutionary Unit (URNG) ended a 36-year-old war, among the oldest and bloodiest in the Western Hemisphere, in which an estimated 140,000 people died.

"This removes the specter of unemployment or other problems later on," URNG commander Ricardo Ramirez, who is known by his nom de guerre Rolando Moran, said at a news conference also attended by Guatemalan government, U.N. and Norwegian officials.
Norway signed an agreement to contribute $3.6 million to the United Nations Development Programme for the first phase of a programme to demobilize guerrilla combatants.

The URNG commander said approximately 3,600 combatants would be demobilized. Although the government previously pinned the rebel numbers at 1,700, Moran said his figure was based on a recent tally at guerrilla camps.

Moran and three other members of the URNG high command visited rebel camps this week. It was the first time since the war began that guerrilla commanders have been able to enter Guatemala legally and travel freely.

He said the United Nations would establish the day when ex-guerrilla fighters will move into six or seven different camps around the country, where they will turn in arms under the scrutiny of international observers.
That decision by the U.N. has been held up in the Security Council because China has opposed sending U.N. peacekeeping forces to protest against Guatemala's close relationship with Taiwan.
Moran said the URNG will form a political party unifying all the "democratic and progresive" forces in the country.
"We want to make a new kind of start, building a party with true roots among the people," he said.
